title: ASC 350-60 Crypto Asset Scope Register
description: Extension schema for the vwp-accounting-asc350-60 extension: the scope register at facts/crypto-assets.json. One entry per asset held, recording the six ASC 350-60-15-1 scope criteria as explicit booleans. The validators check that inScope agrees with the criteria and that every out-of-scope asset names its alternative treatment and links a scoping judgment.

asset.description: Asset symbol or coin id as used in the roll-forward and holdings calculations.

criteria.description: The ASC 350-60-15-1 criteria, each answered explicitly.

inScope.description: Must equal the conjunction of the six criteria.

scopeJudgmentRef.description: Judgment id for the scoping conclusion. Required by the validators for every out-of-scope asset.

criteriaEvidence.description: Evidence ids supporting the criteria answers (whitepaper, token terms, explorer).

outOfScopeTreatment.description: The standard that applies instead (e.g. 'ASC 350-30 indefinite-lived intangible'). Required by the validators when inScope is false.
